name: Orangutan

observation: Long orange shaggy hair, broad cheek flanges, throat pouch, long arms and tailless body distinguish the adult male. Ear visibility is occluded by the flange; curled digits require semantic review. Three-quarter torso rather than a pure lateral fit.
